read_only_paths: 90_候选工作区/current/07_D3跨网格时间步响应诊断/**
prohibited_actions: modify 01_最终理论/** or 02_模拟程序/**
reuse V1/R1 state, trajectory, partial, archive, or checkpoint as a benchmark initial condition
read prohibited state, field, grid-array, observable, or D3 classification values
change any physical equation, geometry, threshold, time step, output schedule, pressure tolerance, preconditioner, CG stopping rule, diagnostic, or classification contract
begin P1 accelerated implementation before a new Pro ruling

p0_d.purpose: Describe the frozen accepted-step numerical diagnostics around the direct projected-divergence trigger without reading physical state or D3 observables.
p0_d.completed_case_artifact: archive/arrays.npz addressed only through archive/result.json arrays.fields metadata
prohibited_numeric_names_or_prefixes: field arrays not mapped to an allowed_logical_series

access_enforcement.completed_archives: Parse only the leading arrays.fields metadata object from result.json, reject duplicate keys, resolve only allowed logical names, and load only the corresponding NPZ members.
access_enforcement.failed_partial: Enumerate all names, reject an allow-list mismatch, and call NPZ member access only for the explicit failed_partial_name_mapping values.
access_enforcement.audit_log: Record every enumerated member, every loaded logical/member name, and physical_observables_read=false.
access_enforcement.unexpected_access: Fail closed before publishing diagnostic results.

series_identity.hash_definition: SHA-256 of dtype.str, shape encoded as little-endian uint64, then C-contiguous array bytes
series_identity.time_identity: Compare float64 values by uint64 bit pattern whenever matching registered output times.

p0_d.threshold_event_definition: projected_divergence >= ratio * frozen projected-divergence limit; report 1-based accepted-step number, time, first, last, and count; report null first/last when count is zero.

frozen_rows.highest_sort: descending projected divergence, then ascending 1-based accepted-step number

descriptive_flags.failure_step_is_registered_output_alignm: Failure-step time is uint64-identical to any registered output time OR limiter code equals the frozen output_alignment code 5.
descriptive_flags.pressure_iteration_robust_outlier: value > median(previous up to 512 steps) + max(6 * MAD(previous up to 512 steps), 1); unavailable when fewer than 32 prior steps
descriptive_flags.divergence_robust_outlier: value > median(previous up to 512 steps) + max(6 * MAD(previous up to 512 steps), 64 * machine_epsilon * max(abs(median), 1e-4)); unavailable when fewer than 32 prior steps
descriptive_flags.interpretation_ceiling: Flags are descriptive and cannot establish a unique numerical mechanism or justify a contract change.

p0_d.completed_case_safety_margin: Report maximum divergence, maximum/limit ratio, and 1 - maximum/limit for every completed case.
p0_d.native_time_comparison: At every uint64-identical registered time present in the accepted-step series, report the frozen diagnostic columns for G6 and G9 across DT0/DT1/DT2; no interpolation is permitted.
p0_d.raw_invariance: Recompute the complete 40-file canonical snapshot immediately before loading any values and again after all P0-D outputs are atomically published; both must equal the frozen hash.

p0_p.purpose: Measure the unchanged formal production path end to end and attribute its wall time, CPU/GPU occupancy, transfers, allocations, pressure solve, archive, and reload costs.

process_policy.scored_samples: Only TIMED_* samples; warm-up and profiled samples are never scored.
process_policy.failure_policy: Any nonzero exit, hard-gate failure, CUDA fallback, archive/reload failure, source/config drift, telemetry gap, or environment validity failure stops the remaining schedule without retrying or replacing the sample.

frozen_thread_environment.library_specific_thread_variables: unset before Python startup so the formal auto policy applies 2 to each supported library

environment_start_gates.invalid_environment_action: Stop without starting a sample; retain telemetry and do not substitute or reorder samples.

required_sample_measurements: end-to-end wall and process CPU time
accepted steps, rejected trials, retries, and accepted steps per second
aggregate and per-thread CPU utilization timeline
GPU utilization, clocks, memory, temperature, power, and throttle-reason timeline
H2D and D2H call count and bytes per accepted step
host and device allocation count and peak memory
pressure solve wall time and pressure iteration distribution
archive write and strict reload wall time
driver, Python, NumPy, SciPy, CuPy, OS, CPU, GPU, affinity, governors, AC, and thread-policy identity
background process identity and thermal state before and after

profile_policy.required_coverage: Python/native hotspots totaling at least 90% measured wall time plus CUDA kernel/API/memcpy timeline sufficient to count and size H2D/D2H transfers.
profile_policy.profiler_unavailable_or_incomplete: Stop P0-P and report the exact missing coverage; do not infer transfer cost from utilization alone.

report_statistics.performance_claim_ceiling: P0 is a baseline and profiler phase; it cannot demonstrate a candidate speedup.

global_stop_conditions: R1 raw, failed partial, preregistration, runner, formal source, or source-config identity drift
an attempted access to a prohibited numeric array or field
a benchmark uses an old trajectory, checkpoint, partial, or archive as initial state
a benchmark hard gate fails or CUDA falls back
environment or telemetry validity gates fail
P0 requires a modification under 02_模拟程序/**
diagnosis requires state, pressure, velocity, grid-array, or D3 observable values
P0-D and P0-P are complete, at which point work stops for Pro review
